verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the API path POST /v3/models/videos, which shows HeyGen exposes version-numbered endpoints. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, changelog commitments or migration guidance, so only half of the story's reliability promise is evidenced, and thinly. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods, a version lifecycle or changelog, migration guides between versions, and independent confirmation of version stability.
